outcome.answer: For Bangla regional spoken-speech data, RegSpeech12 is the closest match: it is a publicly released corpus of spontaneous Bengali speech across dialects, created to support dialect research and regional ASR [1]. BanglaTalk uses RegSpeech12 to evaluate a dialect-aware ASR system covering ten regional dialects [3]. The other dialect resource, 5-Dialects-BN, is an annotated text benchmark rather than spoken-speech data [2].
